note: Provincial-park campground on the north shore of Lac Des Iles in Meadow Lake PP, with a beach and camp kitchen at its east end. Three loops of electric sites in mixed aspen and spruce; the south loop runs along the lakeshore behind a band of shrubs and trees. --Claude
summary: Keep. Live SKPP read: 115 RV sites in loops A/B/C (110 nightly, 5 seasonal), nearly all electric 15/30 (one 15/30/50 double site), no water or sewer hookups, lengths to 70 ft. Showers, dump, potable water. Season May 14 - Sep 30 (2026), October by phone. 'not waterfront' kept, but the stored evidence measures the wrong bay; the south-shore sites may earn lakeview (reviewer). Pin move ~320 m. Phone matches.
flags: SITES: stored count 43 (note prose '43 electric sites', unsourced) -> 115 (A 30 + B 50 + C 36, less M62, a Camp-Easy site).

HOOKUPS: stored water true (note prose 'some with water hookups') -> water false, sewer false: no full-service type in any Murray Doell loop and every site 'Full Hookup - no'. NE-end sites 13-15 (M13 54.46954,-109.36301; M15 54.46988,-109.36293) are ~60-80 m back, with the campground road, the parking, the camp kitchen and the day-use beach in between. Reviewer may upgrade to lakeview for M64/M66/M67/M68.
